Description:
As a shopper, I want to find a product by name so that I can find an item quickly.
Given matching products exist, when a shopper searches by name, then matching names appear.
As a shopper, I want to filter products by category so that I can narrow a long list.

As a shopper, I want to see stock availability so that I can avoid ordering unavailable items.
Given an item has zero sellable stock, when its page loads, then it displays Out of stock and disables Add.
As a shopper, I want to see unit prices so that I can compare pack sizes.

Summary: Add an in-stock item to my cart
Description:
As a shopper, I want to add an in-stock item to my cart so that I can build an order.
Given one item remains, when a shopper adds one, then the cart shows one unit and its price.
As a shopper, I want to change cart quantities so that I can match household needs.

As a shopper, I want to select a delivery window so that I can be home at delivery.
Given a window becomes full, when a shopper selects it, then checkout shows an availability message and keeps the cart.

As a shopper, I want to pay for the order so that I can confirm my purchase.
Given payment is approved, when checkout returns, then the order shows a confirmation reference.
As a shopper, I want to see the current order status so that I can plan for arrival.
As a shopper, I want to receive an out-for-delivery alert so that I can prepare to receive delivery.
As a shopper, I want to view my delivery address so that I can check where the order will arrive.
As a shopper, I want to rate a completed delivery so that I can share feedback.
